name: The Village at Riverstone
summary: The Village at Riverstone is a highly-rated community shopping center in Sugar Land's prestigious Riverstone neighborhood, managed by Regency Centers. This open-air destination offers a convenient mix of retail, dining, and service tenants serving one of Houston's most affluent suburban communities.
demographics: The Village at Riverstone serves the affluent Sugar Land community, attracting upper-middle to high-income families with household incomes typically exceeding $100,000. The primary trade area consists of young professionals, established families with children, and active retirees who value convenience and quality. Shoppers in this area demonstrate strong preferences for upscale grocery options, specialty retail, and family-friendly dining experiences, with frequent visits for both daily necessities and lifestyle purchases.
description: The Village at Riverstone is a premier community shopping center located in the master-planned Riverstone community of Sugar Land, Texas, at the intersection of University Boulevard and LJ Parkway. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, this thriving retail destination serves one of the Houston area's most desirable suburban neighborhoods with a carefully curated mix of national retailers, local merchants, and dining establishments. The center operates daily from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, providing convenient access to essential services and lifestyle amenities for the surrounding community. With an impressive 4.6-star rating from over 674 Google reviews, The Village at Riverstone has established itself as a beloved neighborhood gathering place. The center's open-air design and strategic tenant mix cater to the daily needs and lifestyle preferences of Sugar Land's affluent residents, offering everything from grocery and fitness to salons and medical services in a walkable, community-focused environment.
